dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate curvature; trailing edge follows a deep concave spline from the posterior base to the upper vertical terminus.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse morphological profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior slope, approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal base plane.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of base width to vertical apex height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped notch located on the lower third of the trailing edge; multiple horizontal and diagonal linear white scars across the lateral mid-section and base of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced secondary indentation or 'step' on the trailing edge just below the primary notch.
